prompt: Bootstrap a new top-level lane for this accepted run.
must: Emit a lane-bootstrap/v1 envelope with thread and worktree identity
Persist host receipts for the bootstrap action

prompt: Open a child Lane and route all work through lane-handoff response contracts.
must: Return lane-handoff/v1 with a valid handoff_id
Preserve requested and resolved context in the response

prompt: Dispatch a work unit to an external executor and collect return receipts.
must: Emit work-handoff/v1 return contracts
Record requested and resolved evidence for each dispatched unit
must_not: Mix lane and work handoff in the same action payload

prompt: Observe a host action and verify host-receipt contents.
must: Return a host-receipt/v1 object
Expose status, source, fallback, and payload fields
must_not: Return missing or synthetic receipt ids

prompt: Run host conformance checks for requested, resolved, and actual workflow state.
must: Emit a protocol report with all three status dimensions
Mark PASS, BLOCKED, and FAIL with explicit identity
must_not: Use unknown or missing protocol IDs

prompt: Inject a correction request and continue with corrected execution signals.
must: Accept correction payloads under correction/v1
Return to bootstrap continuation with updated context

prompt: Continue an interrupted run without changing thread identity.
must: Keep thread, worktree, and run identity stable
Reuse existing lane ids when recovery is requested
must_not: Create a new identity without explicit transfer

prompt: Execute a lane under protected-path ownership constraints.
must: Reject writes outside owned paths
Report blocked paths as explicit BLOCKED receipts

prompt: Route two work units across a local scheduler and lane dispatcher.
must: Return independent work-handoff/v1 responses
Record per-unit handoff identifiers and ordered dispatch
must_not: Collapse all units into one unresolved handoff

prompt: After execution, close the task with final completion receipts.
must: Emit final host-receipt entries for accepted and resolved results
Mark completion status without modifying historical peaks
